thread:
nina: FYI hitting a weird browser SDK parsing edge where CRLF splits cause SSE message bodies to be emitted out of order when a resume happens. Happens mostly on slow mobile networks behind our HTTP/2 proxy.
omar: can you paste logs and which transport? EventSource or fetch+streams?
nina: EventSource -> our browser wrapper. logs show the "final" punctuation coming first, then earlier chunks. also noticed the SDK's SSE parser logs an "incomplete event" then later emits the remainder as a new event instead of appending. snippet:
[18:01:11] ev id=1 data="Start"
[18:01:14] ev id=4 data="!"  <-- final arrives early
[18:01:17] ev id=2 data=", hi"
[18:01:18] ev id=3 data=" there"

jin: interesting. could be the parser splitting on `\r\n\r\n` boundary and mis-associating `data:` lines if a chunk split falls between `\r` and `\n`. If the runtime resends buffered fragments during a resume, they can interleave with in-flight fragments.
andrea: we've seen similar when token refresh and reconnect overlap. runtime currently doesn't attach a resume token for SSE, so the SDK re-requests and the gateway may replay remaining buffered events while un-acked frames still trickle through. SDK should include a small state machine: buffer incomplete events, accept `id:` monotonic seq, and merge fragments with the same id when they arrive.
nina: repro plan: nghttp2 proxy with forced H2 DATA frame split at random offsets + throttle to 90kbps, then trigger token refresh at 3s. i can reproduce locally.
omar: short-term mitigation: SDK config `bufferIncompleteEvents:true` and `reorderById:true` behind feature flag. Also add a diagnostic metric `sdk.stream.ofo_count` when out-of-order detected.
jin: runtime action: add `X-Chunk-Seq` header and include SSE `id:` equal to seq on every event. That makes it trivial for clients to reorder and dedupe. Also add `X-Stream-Session` header to tie fragments across reconnects.
andrea: devexp: add a tiny failing test in sampleapp: start a long stream, force token expiry at t=3s, throttle + frame-split proxy; assert that rendered text equals concatenated seq order 1..N. Put test in sampleapp/ci/stream-reorder.spec.
devx-bot: filed infra ticket #5777 "sse: support chunk seq + session headers; add sampleapp repro and SDK reorder option" https://git.redwood/infra/issues/5777 :robot_face:
nina: i'll draft a small patch to the browser SDK that buffers incomplete events and reorders by `id:` if present, behind a feature flag. will link QA repro. thanks! :thumbsup:
